name: SudoGate
author: tomasWade
description: SudoGate review panel: sudo-elevation badge on the bar (key + count, dimmed at zero), click to review host/user/cwd/command and hand-enter the password. Companion UI for sudogate-server.

barWidget.description: Sudo review badge: key + pending count, dimmed when idle. Click to review and approve.

schema.label: Runtime dir
schema.description: Directory holding sudogate.sock.ctl and sudogate.state. Empty = XDG_RUNTIME_DIR.

schema.label: sudogate-server path
schema.description: Path to the sudogate-server binary (approve/deny subcommands). Empty = auto-detect (~/.local/bin, then the dev build location).

schema.label: Request deadline (seconds)
schema.description: Per-request wait timeout the server is running with; drives the countdown display. Must match the server's -timeout.

schema.label: Demo data
schema.description: Render canned pending requests (no server needed) for previewing the visuals.

schema.label: Hide when nothing pending
schema.description: Default shows the badge at all times (dimmed key + 0 when idle) so the plugin slot and server health stay visible. Turn on to collapse the badge completely while the queue is empty.
